_help: Chat window (official UI/StatusBar3.img/chat art). Game pixels in 1366x768. x,y = the window top-left. The tab row sits on top: tabX/tabY = where it starts, tabGap = the gap between the tabs, the tabs keep the official 54x20 art size. The log frame is under it (logY/logH). The input line is at the bottom (inputY/inputH) and only shows while a line is typed. logPadX/logPadY = the gap from the frame edge to the text. logGap = the gap between the wrapped text and the scroll bar. lineH = the height of one log line. nameGap = the gap between the name and the text of a line. caretDx/caretDy/caretW/caretH = the caret box in the input line. border = the corner size of the nine piece frame. capW = the width of the left and right cap of the input bar. chevGap = the gap from the right edge to the chevron button (it folds the chat); chevY = the chevron row, tabY when the file has no chevY. plusW = the width of the plus box at the right end of the folded line (the only spot that opens the chat again). tabW/tabH, chevW/chevH, targetW/targetH, scrollW = the box sizes of those parts: the art is stretched to its box, so these change the picture too. minH = the height of the folded chat (one row of the newest line and a plus); the folded bar is as wide as the window (w). minPad = the gap from the folded bar edge to that text. fieldX = the left edge of the input field. targetX/targetY = the spot of the chat target button (60x24, it sends the line to the party instead of the world). The folded line sits on the bottom edge of the h tall box, so folding goes down and opening grows up.
